title: Decide where marketing waitlist and contact intake lives before the production cutover
description:
## Plan step 5 (gates production cutover, not the merge)
chattic.us /api* proxies to the legacy production thin-turn Lambda Function URL and serves POST /api/waitlist/survey, /api/waitlist/confirm, /api/waitlist/invite and /api/contact. The TypeScript control plane does not implement them. When legacy production thin-turn is replaced, signups and contact submissions fail. Options: a small Lambda in the website repo reading and writing the existing WAITLIST and CONTACT items in the Messaging table, or a bounded bridge keeping legacy thin-turn only for those routes.
## Decision: D4. Related: chatticus-574e4b, chatticus-8912d6.
## Acceptance
- The chosen option is recorded and built; waitlist and contact submissions succeed with legacy production thin-turn removed (verified on staging first).
Source: docs/PROMOTE_TO_MAIN.md (PR 534, branch ts/promote-to-main-plan). Nothing has been executed; owner decisions are in the 'Decisions needed from the owner' ticket.
right_now_summary: The owner still needs to choose and build the waitlist and contact API before production cutover.
